meta_description: Cerulean blue beveled mosaic tiles in glazed ceramic squares for bathroom walls and shower areas. See them in Lahore or Islamabad. Free WhatsApp sample.
description:
These cerulean blue beveled mosaic tiles are glazed ceramic squares with a bevelled edge, made for bathroom walls, shower areas and vanity backs where you want a clear blue wall with a little depth.

## How they look
Each square has a sloped, bevelled edge, so the face of the tile sits slightly raised and the edges catch light. On a full wall this tends to give a soft, quilted shine that flat tiles do not have. Cerulean is a bright, sky-to-sea blue; blue glazes often look different under daylight and warm bathroom bulbs, so judge it in your own room.

## Where they work
- **Full bathroom walls** in blue beveled square tiles with white sanitaryware.
- **Shower walls**, where the glazed face is generally simple to wipe down.
- **A vanity or mirror wall**, as a band of colour in an otherwise neutral room.

For blue bathroom wall tiles, a white grout keeps the grid crisp; a grey grout tends to hide marks better in a busy family bathroom.

## Good to know
- Material: glazed ceramic mosaic
- Colour: cerulean blue
- Shape: beveled square
- Category: bathroom wall mosaic tiles
- Size: confirm on enquiry

Set mosaics on a flat, waterproofed wall and keep the joints even so the bevels line up. Clean with a mild, non-acid cleaner.

## See it before you order
Pak Clay shows its range at the Lahore head office on Walton Road (opposite Packages Mall Gate 2) and at G-04 Civic Center, Executive Block, Gulberg Greens, Islamabad, Monday to Saturday, 9 am to 9 pm. Ask for a [free sample on WhatsApp](https://wa.me/923004617715) to see the blue in your bathroom light, then get a dated quote. Other shapes are in the [bathroom wall mosaic range](/categories/bathroom-wall-tiles-mosaic), and a softer blue is the [turquoise rectangular mosaic](/products/turquoise-glazed-ceramic-mosaic-rectangular-bathroom-wall-tiles).

faqs.q: What is the price of beveled mosaic tiles in Pakistan?
faqs.a: Pak Clay does not publish a fixed rate online. The price depends on the quantity, the area to cover and delivery to your city, so send your measurements on WhatsApp (+92 300 4617715) for a dated written quote.

faqs.q: Are beveled tiles harder to clean?
faqs.a: Slightly. The bevelled edge forms a small groove at each joint where soap can collect, so a quick wipe after showers and a mild cleaner tend to keep them bright.

faqs.q: Beveled or flat square mosaic: which is better for a bathroom?
faqs.a: Flat squares give a smooth, modern wall that is the easiest to clean. Beveled squares add depth and shine, which suits a feature wall or a room where the tiles are the main decoration.

faqs.q: Can I see a sample before ordering?
faqs.a: Yes. Message Pak Clay on WhatsApp at +92 300 4617715 with "Cerulean Blue Beveled Square Mosaic" and your city, or visit the Lahore showroom on Walton Road or the Islamabad location at G-04 Civic Center, Gulberg Greens, Monday to Saturday, 9 am to 9 pm.
